applicabilityBasis.summary: sFRAX is a value-accruing ERC-4626 savings share redeemable for pro-rata legacy FRAX, not a fixed-dollar payment token.

references.label: Frax sFRAX staking and redemption disclosure

genius.notes: This prominent legacy-FRAX wrapper is separately identified from FRAX and sfrxUSD to avoid confusing its pro-rata savings claim with a payment-stablecoin authorization. No GENIUS authorization or legal issuer approval is asserted. MiCA remains unassessed.

references.label: Verified sFRAX reward accounting and share implementation
